svg.title: Redis Pub/Sub vs Kafka — core difference
svg.desc: Left side shows Redis pub/sub: publisher sends to channel, if subscriber is offline the message vanishes. Right side shows Kafka: messages are written to a persistent log on disk, offline consumers can catch up later using offsets.
svg.text: where losing a message is OK

g.text: written to disk · kept for 7 days

svg.text: where losing a message is NOT OK
